channels.name: Telegram
channels.note: Answering today through the OpenClaw gateway, which long-polls mentions for @pairoobot.

channels.name: X
channels.note: Authenticated as @pairoobot. The mentions endpoint needs a paid API plan — it answers 402 today.

channels.name: Discord
channels.note: Worker running. Reads mentions and replies; verified in a live server.

channels.name: Reddit
channels.note: Reddit stopped registering new API apps in November 2025 and its .json endpoints returned 403 from May 2026. There is no free path in; commercial access is negotiated.

channels.name: Instagram
channels.note: Webhook ingress plus Ayrshare egress. Live-token verification pending.

channels.name: TikTok
channels.note: Receiving real mentions is proven. Posting needs access not yet granted.

chains.name: Solana
chains.note: Executor built and the plan simulates byte-identical to the frozen report. No signature has been produced yet: the launch key is not on the host.

chains.name: Solana
chains.note: Verified 2026-09-11: the platform cannot bind an 80/20 split — no API field, fees accrue to one wallet, and we sign a payment rather than the launch.

chains.name: Robinhood Chain
chains.note: Deploy dry-run measured on chain: 0.00018 ETH to deploy, 0.00137 with the first launch. Creator-fee cap read at 10%. The wallet holds nothing.

chains.name: BNB Chain
chains.note: Adapter built against the deployed implementation; 8 of 12 published pairs are tokenized stocks. The createArg encoding is undocumented, so nothing is signed.

roadmap.title: Launching on Solana
items: Two coins created on mainnet tonight, both confirmed on chain
The 80/20 creator-fee split is locked inside the launch transaction itself
Real cost measured at 0.0146 to 0.0163 SOL per launch
Discord answers mentions; Telegram answers through the gateway

roadmap.title: Every feed, every language
items: A request is read by the model and validated by code — Portuguese, English, typos and all
A mistyped pair is proposed back, never substituted
X: the credentials authenticate, the mentions endpoint needs a paid plan
Instagram and TikTok access; Reddit no longer issues API access

roadmap.title: More chains
items: Robinhood Chain through Pons: contract reviewed, deploy measured at 0.00018 ETH
BNB Chain through four.meme: adapter built against the deployed contract
Naming a chain already constrains the route — it launches there or says why not

roadmap.title: Creator payouts
items: Wallet binding per author, one address per channel identity
Claim flow for the creator share
A trade settling fees to both sides, proven end to end
